prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
EDIT reference image 1 into a new JACK RUSSELL EAR COMPARISON board. ONLY the FIRST ROW A of reference1 is the approved character and shading. Start by copying that same A row across all three rows, then modify ONLY ears as described. Discard reference1 B/C lighter/darker shadow variations: all new rows must share precisely the original A facial color/shadow coverage.

Preserve the approved Jack Russell's exact low head/skull shape, muzzle length/depth, nose and round dot eyes, eye spacing, short supported neck, white coat, muted tan ear color, pixel outline thickness/hue, pixel-cluster density, upper-left illumination and all NON-EAR pixels as closely as possible. No change to face shading outside the tiny ear attachment contact shadow. Do not shorten muzzle, dome the cranium, enlarge eyes, turn dog into corgi/chihuahua, introduce fur markings, collar or smile. Reference2 is canonical B2 STYLE ONLY (never transfer its breed anatomy). Match the same soft connected stepped shadows and warm brown colored outline.

Output ONE landscape 3 rows x 5 columns comparison sheet, all cells fully visible. Columns "SIDE", "3-4", "FRONT", "BACK", "TOP". Preserve all five reference1 view directions and head/body positions, base scale and ivory paper-like background. Title "JACK RUSSELL / EAR STUDY". Row labels at far left "1", "2", "3". Footer "1 FOLDED / 2 SEMI / 3 UPRIGHT". Keep short labels legible without collision.

ROW 1 FOLDED: reproduce approved row A's small tan triangular forward-button folded ears. Root at original high lateral cranium, distal leaf folded forward/down over ear opening, tip down. This is the unchanged baseline.
ROW 2 SEMI: SAME ear root and same unrolled leaf length/width as baseline. Lower HALF of leaf rises upright off skull; upper half distinctly bends FORWARD and slightly down. An obvious soft hinge and short drooping triangular tip. Mid-height silhouette between row1 and row3. Do not merely rotate the folded ear into a spike. Both left and right ears have this structural fold. No exposed deep black hole.
ROW 3 UPRIGHT: SAME ear root, leaf length and width unfolded into a SMALL compact upright triangular ear with subtly rounded tip, base continuous with head. Both ears standing, gently outward spread, with subtle inner tan shadow facing toward nose/front. Keep modest height (unfolded ear not tall huge shepherd/rabbit ears), same tan material. In rear view show outer backs, not front ear cavities; side view naturally overlaps the far ear; top view projects upright ear correctly rather than copying frontal triangle.

Preserve left/right pair symmetry within each candidate, but represent actual occlusion/rotation in each view. These are three alternative baseline ear configurations of same character, not emotions or animation frames. Ear folding/standing is the ONLY variable; no change to head shape or lighting between rows. High-resolution pixel STYLE concept, not native64 or 3D projection proof.
scope: Approved Jack A appearance; ear fold configurations only. Authored visual candidates, not observed individual anatomy or native64. No engine mutation.
